Lsningen er selvflgelig ikke at afskaffe trafiklysene, men i stedet at forsge at undg en situation, hvor de kan medfre uhensigtsmssigheder. Det betyder konkret, at selskaberne skal afpasse reserveopbygning til risikotagning. Sektorens ansvar Den voksende danske pensionsformue stiller krav til sektoren om fortsat ansvarlighed med hensyn til investeringsadfrd, men ogs til produktudbud og markedsfring. Bde de kommercielle svel som arbejdsmarkedspensionskasserne har i stigende grad nsket, at kunderne overgr til markedsrenteprodukter, dvs. produkter hvor afkastet mere direkte kobles op p markedsudviklingen p de finansielle markeder. Herved skubbes en strre del af investeringsrisikoen over p den enkelte pensionsopsparer. Et af argumenterne, som pensionsselskaberne ofte bruger, nr de skal slge et "markedsprodukt", er, at afkastet typisk er bedre end ved en traditionel pensionsopsparing. Det vil jeg ikke udelukke er tilfldet, men der er sjldent nogen "free lunch". Et strre forventet afkast m ndvendigvis vre forbundet med mere risiko. Det er derfor vigtigt, at pensionsselskaberne er bevidste om det rdgiveransvar, de har. Der findes ikke noget sikkert svar p, hvordan rente og aktiekurser vil udvikle sig i fremtiden. Det samme kan siges om rdgivning, der er baseret p skattemssige aspekter. Ingen kan sledes vide, hvordan skattesystemet vil vre skruet sammen om 20-30 r i forhold til den enkeltes indkomstsammenstning. Det er klart, at krisen i pensionssektoren, der fulgte i klvandet p aktienedturen fra 2000-2002, gav mange selskaber lidt af et granatchok. Faldende aktiekurser kombineret med lavere renter og stigende levealder var en farlig cocktail. 10 En af udfordringerne for branchen har derfor vret at undg at komme til at st i en lignende situation. Mange har forsgt med netop en lsning baseret p individuelle produkter, hvor pensionsopsparerne selv brer de fleste af risiciene. Det er en bemrkelsesvrdig udvikling. Det burde ellers vre p dette omrde, at selskaberne har en komparativ fordel vedrrende pensionsopsparing sammenlignet med den vrige finansielle sektor. 6. P dansk betyder det, at et selskab med hje omkostninger i dag har stor sandsynlighed for ogs at have hje omkostninger i morgen. Det samme glder, hvis selskabet har lave omkostninger. Og selv ganske sm forskelle i omkostningsprocenter kan i lbet af et arbejdsliv blive til flere hundrede tusinde kroner for den enkelte i ren opsparing p pensionstidspunktet. Det understreger vigtigheden af at have fokus p omkostningerne, men ogs behovet for gennemsigtighed, s kunderne kan se, hvad de betaler, og hvad de betaler for. - 0 - Pensionssektoren er i dag en afgrende del af dansk konomi, og intet tyder p, at dette billede vil ndre sig i fremtiden. I takt med, at de store krigsrgange gr p pension, og den forventede levealder for befolkningen stiger, vil det danske samfund opleve nogle strukturelle ndringer, hvor behovet for en velfungerende pensionssektor helt benlyst vil vre til stede. Det er derfor positivt, at pensionssektoren har fet stigende fokus p risikostyring og -afdkning, og at en stadig strre andel af danskerne sparer op til egen pension.

Title: Speech at the Danish Mortgage Bankers Association's annual meeting
text: Basis of speech. The spoken word applies Nils Bernstein Speech at the Danish Mortgage Bankers Association's annual meeting on 26 April 2007 Thanks for the invitation. *** Growth in the world economy remains high. The pace has slowed down a bit in the United States, but the recovery in Europe and many other parts of the world has become clearer. The major global imbalances d0 here I am thinking of the large current account deficit in the United States, which is matched by large surpluses in, among other things. China and in the oil-producing countries d0 have diminished slightly, and the risk of abrupt adjustments has diminished without being eliminated. The lower growth in the US reflects, among other things, that the housing market is adjusting after a number of years of strong price increases, but the adjustment appears to be moderate and gradual. Nor does it appear that the problems of companies specialising in home loans to less creditworthy households will spread to other parts of the capital markets. Concerns that the European recovery would be stifled by the German VAT hike have been called off, and Germany, as an economic dynamo, is on the upswing. Overall, this bodes well for Danish exports, which will not suffer from a lack of demand in the near future. Rather, it may suffer from a lack of production capacity. The Danish economy is running at the capacity limit, and many companies find it difficult to obtain the labour they want. Put more positively, employment in Denmark has never been higher than it is now, and unemployment is the lowest since the early 1970s and also one of the lowest in the world. At the same time, this implies that there is a narrow limit to economic growth in the coming period. With the prospect of continued growth in domestic demand, capacity pressures will persist. It will very much be up to us here in Denmark to ensure that we can benefit from the continuing international boom. *** 2 The housing market has been subdued over the past year after a period of very strong growth in cash prices d0 so strong that it has also attracted international attention. The question at home has recently been whether we are facing a period of free fall in house prices. Some downward correction in prices in the areas where price increases have been highest cannot be ruled out. However, due to the strong Danish economy, it is not likely that we will face drastic and general price drops. It is in itself an advantage that the expectations for the future price development of owner-occupied homes have been subdued, so as to avoid that the prospect of capital gains becomes a central motive when buying a home. The change of mood seems to have been most marked in the metropolitan area. It is also in Copenhagen that we have recently seen a fall in house prices d0 especially for owner-occupied flats. This reflects the fact that square footage prices have risen very high and that the supply of newly built homes has taken off. Construction always responds with some delay to rising home prices. However, economic growth in the metropolitan area is still high, and there is an influx of residents from the rest of the country. That will put a bottom below prices. Three-quarters of the country's owner-occupied housing is located outside the metropolitan area. In most places, price trends have been slower, and the likelihood of falls is less. The increase in square footage prices in recent years has meant a strong increase in housing wealth. It has increased by 670 mia.kr. since early 2005. Borrowing has also increased, but not to the same extent. The home values have grown by an estimated 550 mia.kr. over two years. It provides quite a significant buffer possible price drops. Rising house prices are primarily in favor of those who already own a home. Homeowners make up a majority of the population, and this is probably one of the explanations for the fact that no major protests have been heard over the sharp price increases. Stagnation and possible fall in house prices will benefit those facing entering the housing market. Of course, for those who have bought when prices peaked, any price drop will be unpleasant. However, only a small part of the owner-occupied homes are traded at the very high prices. About 5 per cent of the country's detached houses are traded every year, so for the majority of homeowners, a slight fall in prices will only mean that a small part of a quickly achieved capital gain disappears again. The increase in interest rates also implies that the market value of the outstanding debt has decreased, unless the property is financed at a variable rate. It is Danmarks Nationalbank's assessment that the slowdown in the housing market in the shorter term will have only a limited effect on the general economy. When queuing- 3 At some point, we will probably see a slowdown in new and remodeling activity, but we are far from there yet. In addition, commercial construction is on the rise. In addition, private consumption has only to a lesser extent been affected by the increasing housing wealth. Since 2004, consumption propensity has increased corresponding to about 15 mia.kr, while housing wealth has increased by 670 mia.kr. While the capital gains have been further mortgaged, the proceeds have been predominantly used for home improvements, retirement savings or other financial assets. *** For more than 200 years, we have had a secure housing finance system with a large and standardized mortgage bond market, which has given borrowers equal access to real estate financing at a long capital market rate. However, the mortgage system has undergone many changes in recent times: Mortgage lenders are no longer borrower associations of jointly and severally liable members who organise themselves jointly to gain access to a weakly developed capital market. Today, these are profit-maximizing joint-stock companies in an economy with well-developed capital markets. Mortgage banks and banks have been linked more closely together in different ways. Credit institutions from the EU are free to compete in Denmark, and Danish credit institutions have become active in property financing abroad. Finally, there has been significant product development d0 for example, adjustable-rate loans, loans with interest rate ceilings and interest-only loans. In this way, mortgage credit has become a product in line with other commercial financial products in an open economy with a well-developed financial system. This dynamic has not changed Danmarks Nationalbank's fundamental attitude towards the mortgage system. Danmarks Nationalbank has always been of the opinion that it is a safe system that is good for borrowers, lenders, the capital market and financial stability. Now comes a new variant of bonds on the market, namely covered bonds, SDO. At the annual meeting last year, I called for a thorough review of the upcoming rules for the use of SDOs. I would like to acknowledge that we have done this work-through. There is now a political settlement on a law for the SDO. Overall, it is my opinion that the result is good. At the same time, the bill allows mortgage banks to provide home loans financed by bond issues in exactly the same way as today. This has been important for Danmarks Nationalbank. 4 For several years, the banks have competed with mortgage banks to provide home loans, including the introduction of mortgages. In addition, they increasingly compete with foreign institutes d0 both in Denmark and abroad. Now financial institutions will have the opportunity to finance themselves by issuing SDO with security in loans with a mortgage on real estate. It sharpens competition. At the same time, it provides banks with a new and stable source of funding to cover the growing deposit deficit for the benefit of financial stability. I will not hide the fact that we at Danmarks Nationalbank think that the current legislation for mortgage credit has worked well, and a strict balance sheet principle has been a cornerstone in this context. The purpose of a balance sheet principle is to limit the issuer's risk to credit risk only. Both the current and the proposed new balance sheet principle have as a basic rule that no interest rate, option or exchange rate risks may be taken. Today, risks are mainly hedged by selling bonds that are quite similar to home loans d0 and of course this will also be an option under the new balance sheet principle, if you wish. However, the new balance sheet principle opens the way for modern financial instruments to be used to hedge risks to a greater extent. In addition, the new legislation on CB contains a directive-specific tightening in relation to mortgage legislation, namely that each home loan during the entire term of the loan must not have a value that exceeds 80 per cent of the value of the home being mortgaged. Today, as you know, it only applies when the loan is taken. If house prices fall, credit institutions must, to the extent necessary, re-establish the security behind the issued SDOs, e.g. by taking out loans and buying government securities that can be added to collateral. This means that there will always be good security behind the new CBs, and this will limit the refinancing risk. Overall, it is Danmarks Nationalbank's assessment that the regulation of SDO forms the basis for an equally secure housing financing system as the mortgage system today. Now we have to see how the market will take on the new bonds. The fact that there is now a new financing instrument in the area of housing finance, which can also be used by financial institutions, is generally expected to increase competition. There's no harm in that. However, this view presupposes that consumers are active and that they are able to see through the offers they receive. There is quite extensive work to be done in designing methods to create transparency. *** 5 The cross-border integration of financial markets is one of the more significant phenomena over the past 30 years. This places high demands on the underlying infrastructure. High costs continue to be associated with cross-border securities trading. Against this background, the European Central Bank, the ECB, has taken the initiative to improve cross-border trade in securities in the EU. TARGET2-Securities is the name of a new pan-European system for the settlement of securities, first and foremost issued in euro, but later also for settlement in other currencies. The aim of the project is to make it as simple, cheap and efficient to settle transactions in securities across national borders in the EU as it is to settle a national trade. The ECB expects to take a final position on whether to develop the system in early 2008. In the coming time, the requirements of users for the system will have to be determined. Danmarks Nationalbank and the Central Securities Depository have begun the collection and coordination of the Danish user requirements. *** I would like to conclude by thanking, on behalf of Danmarks Nationalbank, the good cooperation we have had with both the Danish Mortgage Credit Council and its members over the past year. ***
text_original: Grundlag for talen. Det talte ord glder Nils Bernstein Tale p Realkreditrdets rsmde 26. april 2007 Tak for indbydelsen. *** Vksten i verdenskonomien er fortsat hj. Tempoet er get lidt ned i USA, men opsvinget i Europa og mange andre dele af verden er blevet tydeligere. De store globale ubalancer  her tnker jeg p det store betalingsbalanceunderskud i USA, som modsvares af store overskud i bl.a. Kina og i de olieproducerende lande  er blevet lidt mindre, og risikoen for abrupte tilpasninger er aftagende uden dog at vre elimineret. Den lavere vkst i USA afspejler bl.a., at boligmarkedet er ved at tilpasse sig efter en rrkke med strke prisstigninger, men tilpasningen ser ud til at blive moderat og gradvis. Det ser heller ikke ud til, at de problemer, der er i selskaber, der har specialiseret sig i boligln til mindre kreditvrdige husholdninger, vil brede sig til andre dele af kapitalmarkederne. Bekymringen for, om det europiske opsving ville blive kvalt af den tyske momsforhjelse, er blevet afblst, og Tyskland som konomisk dynamo er p vej op i omdrejninger. Samlet set tegner det godt for den danske eksport, som ikke kommer til at lide af mangel p eftersprgsel i den kommende tid. Den kan snarere komme til at lide under mangel p produktionskapacitet. Den danske konomi krer p kapacitetsgrnsen, og mange virksomheder har svrt ved at skaffe den arbejdskraft, de nsker. Formuleret mere positivt har beskftigelsen i Danmark aldrig vret hjere end nu, og arbejdslsheden er den laveste siden begyndelsen af 1970'erne og ligeledes en af de laveste i verden. Det indebrer samtidigt, at der er en snver grnse for den konomiske vkst i den kommende tid. Med udsigt til fortsat vkst i den indenlandske eftersprgsel vil kapacitetspresset vare ved. Det vil i hj grad vre op til os selv her i Danmark at sikre, at vi kan drage fordel af den fortsatte internationale hjkonjunktur. *** 2 Boligmarkedet er blevet afdmpet i lbet af det seneste r efter en periode med meget kraftig vkst i kontantpriserne  s kraftig, at det ogs har tiltrukket sig international opmrksomhed. Sprgsmlet herhjemme har i den seneste tid vret, om vi str over for en periode med frit fald i boligpriserne. En vis nedadrettet korrektion i priserne i de omrder, hvor prisstigningerne har vret strst, kan ikke udelukkes. I kraft af den strke danske konomi er det dog ikke sandsynligt, at vi str over for drastiske og generelle prisfald. Det er i sig selv en fordel, at forventningerne til den fremtidige prisudvikling p ejerboliger er blevet afdmpet, s man undgr, at udsigten til kapitalgevinster bliver et centralt motiv ved boligkb. Stemningsskiftet synes at have vret mest markant i hovedstadsomrdet. Det er ogs i Kbenhavn, at vi p det seneste har set fald i boligpriserne  isr for ejerlejligheder. Det afspejler, at kvadratmeter-priserne er kommet meget hjt op, og at udbuddet af nybyggede boliger har taget fart. Byggeriet reagerer altid med en vis forsinkelse p stigende boligpriser. Den konomiske vkst i hovedstadsomrdet er dog stadig hj, og der er tilgang af indbyggere fra resten af landet. Det vil lgge en bund under priserne. Trefjerdedele af landets ejerboliger er beliggende uden for hovedstadsomrdet. Der har udviklingen i priserne de fleste steder vret langsommere, og sandsynligheden for fald er mindre. Stigningen i kvadratmeter-priserne de senere r har betydet en strk forgelse af boligformuen. Den er steget med 670 mia.kr. siden begyndelsen af 2005. Lntagningen er ogs steget, men slet ikke i samme omfang. Frivrdierne er sknsmssigt vokset med 550 mia.kr. over to r. Det giver en ganske betydelig stdpude over for eventuelle prisfald. Stigende boligpriser er frst og fremmest til fordel for dem, der allerede ejer en bolig. Boligejerne udgr et flertal i befolkningen, og det er nok n af forklaringerne p, at der ikke er hrt strre protester over de kraftige prisstigninger. Stagnation og eventuelt fald i boligpriserne vil vre til gavn for dem, der str over for at trde ind p boligmarkedet. For dem, der har kbt, da priserne toppede, vil et eventuelt prisfald naturligvis vre ubehageligt. Det er dog kun en lille del af ejerboligerne, der er handlet til de meget hje priser. Omkring 5 pct. af landets parcelhuse bliver handlet hvert r, s for hovedparten af boligejerne vil et mindre prisfald blot betyde, at en lille del af en hurtigt opnet kapitalgevinst forsvinder igen. Rentestigningen indebrer desuden, at kursvrdien af restglden er faldet, medmindre boligen er finansieret til variabel rente. Det er Nationalbankens vurdering, at opbremsningen p boligmarkedet p kortere sigt kun fr en begrnset effekt p den generelle konomi. Nr k- 3 dannelserne i byggeriet p et tidspunkt er afviklet, vil vi nok se en opbremsning i ny- og ombygningsaktiviteten, men vi er langt fra der endnu. Desuden er erhvervsbyggeriet p vej frem. Hertil kommer, at privatforbruget kun i mindre omfang er blevet pvirket af de stigende boligformuer. Forbrugstilbjeligheden er siden 2004 steget svarende til ca. 15 mia.kr., mens boligformuerne som nvnt er steget med 670 mia.kr. Kapitalgevinsterne er ganske vist blevet yderligere belnt, men provenuet er overvejende blevet anvendt til boligforbedringer, pensionsopsparing eller andre finansielle aktiver. *** Vi har gennem mere end 200 r haft et sikkert boligfinansieringssystem med et stort og standardiseret realkreditobligationsmarked, som har givet lntagere lige adgang til finansiering af fast ejendom til en lang kapitalmarkedsrente. Realkreditsystemet har imidlertid underget mange forandringer i nyere tid: Realkreditten er ikke lngere lntagerforeninger af solidarisk hftende medlemmer, som organiserer sig i fllesskab for at f adgang til et svagt udviklet kapitalmarked. I dag er der tale om profitmaksimerende aktieselskaber i en konomi med veludviklede kapitalmarkeder. Realkredit- og pengeinstitutter er blevet knyttet tttere sammen p forskellig vis. Kreditinstitutter fra EU kan frit konkurrere i Danmark, og danske kreditinstitutter er blevet aktive i ejendomsfinansiering i udlandet. Endelig har der vret en betydelig produktudvikling  eksempelvis rentetilpasningsln, ln med renteloft og afdragsfrie ln. Realkredit er p den mde blevet et produkt p linje med andre kommercielle finansielle produkter i en ben konomi med et veludviklet finansielt system. Denne dynamik har ikke ndret ved Nationalbankens grundlggende holdning til realkreditsystemet. Nationalbanken har altid vret af den opfattelse, at det er et sikkert system, som er godt for lntagere, lngivere, kapitalmarkedet og den finansielle stabilitet. Nu kommer s en ny variant af obligationer p markedet, nemlig srligt dkkede obligationer, SDO. P rsmdet sidste r efterlyste jeg en grundig gennemarbejdning af de kommende regler for anvendelse af SDO. Jeg vil gerne kvittere for, at vi har fet lavet denne gennemarbejdning. Der er nu politisk forlig om en lov for SDO. Samlet set er det min opfattelse, at resultatet er godt. Lovforslaget giver samtidig mulighed for, at realkreditinstitutterne kan yde boligln finansieret ved obligationsudstedelser p fuldstndig samme vis som i dag. Det har vret vigtigt for Nationalbanken. 4 Pengeinstitutterne har i flere r konkurreret med realkreditinstitutterne om at yde boligln, bl.a. med introduktionen af prioritetsln. Desuden konkurrerer de i stigende grad med udenlandske institutter  bde i Danmark og i udlandet. Nu fr pengeinstitutterne mulighed for at finansiere sig ved at udstede SDO med sikkerhed i ln med pant i fast ejendom. Det skrper konkurrencen. Det giver samtidig pengeinstitutterne en ny og stabil finansieringskilde til at dkke det voksende indlnsunderskud til gavn for den finansielle stabilitet. Jeg vil ikke lgge skjul p, at vi i Nationalbanken synes, at den gldende lovgivning for realkredit har fungeret godt, og et stramt balanceprincip har i den sammenhng vret en hjrnesten. Formlet med et balanceprincip er at begrnse udstederens risiko til kun kreditrisiko. Bde det nuvrende og forslaget til nyt balanceprincip har som grundregel, at der ikke m tages rente-, options- eller valutakursrisici. I dag bliver risici hovedsageligt afdkket ved at slge obligationer, som er helt magen til boliglnene  og det vil selvflgelig ogs vre en mulighed under det nye balanceprincip, hvis man nsker det. Men med det nye balanceprincip bnes der op for, at der i hjere grad kan anvendes moderne finansielle instrumenter til at afdkke risici. Den nye lovgivning om SDO indeholder derudover en direktiv-bestemt stramning i forhold til realkreditlovgivningen, nemlig at hvert boligln i hele lnets lbetid ikke m have en vrdi, der overstiger 80 pct. af vrdien af den bolig, der belnes. I dag glder det som bekendt kun, nr lnet optages. Hvis huspriserne falder, skal kreditinstitutterne i forndent omfang reetablere sikkerheden bag de udstedte SDO, fx ved at optage ln og kbe statspapirer, der kan lgges til sikkerhed. Det betyder, at der altid vil vre god sikkerhed bag de nye SDO, og det vil begrnse refinansieringsrisikoen. Samlet set er det Nationalbankens vurdering, at reguleringen af SDO danner grundlag for et lige s sikkert boligfinansieringssystem som realkreditsystemet i dag. Nu har vi til gode at se, hvorledes markedet vil tage imod de nye obligationer. Det forhold, at der nu p boligfinansieringsomrdet kommer et nyt finansieringsinstrument, som ogs kan anvendes af pengeinstitutter, m som udgangspunkt forventes at skrpe konkurrencen. Det er ingen skade til. Synspunktet forudstter imidlertid, at forbrugerne er aktive, og at de er i stand til at gennemskue de tilbud, de fr. Der udestr et ganske omfattende arbejde med at udforme metoder til at skabe gennemsigtighed. *** 5 Integrationen af de finansielle markeder over landegrnserne er et af de mere markante fnomener over de seneste 30 r. Det stiller store krav til den underliggende infrastruktur. Store omkostninger er fortsat forbundet med handel med vrdipapirer over grnserne. Den Europiske Centralbank, ECB, har p den baggrund taget initiativ til forbedring af den grnseoverskridende handel med vrdipapirer i EU. Target2-Securities er betegnelsen for et nyt flleseuropisk system for afvikling af vrdipapirer frst og fremmest udstedt i euro, men senere ogs for afvikling i andre valutaer. Formlet med projektet er, at det skal vre liges enkelt, billigt og effektivt at afvikle handler med vrdipapirer p tvrs af landegrnserne i EU, som det er at afvikle en national handel. ECB forventer at tage endelig stilling til, hvorvidt systemet skal udvikles, i begyndelsen af 2008. I den kommende tid skal brugernes krav til systemet fastlgges. Nationalbanken og Vrdipapircentralen har pbegyndt indsamlingen og koordineringen af de danske brugerkrav. *** Jeg vil gerne slutte med, p Nationalbankens vegne, at takke for det gode samarbejde, vi har haft med bde Realkreditrdet og dets medlemmer i det forgangne r. ***

Title: Speech at the opening of the Danish Money Museum's special exhibition
text: Torben Nielsen's speech at the opening of the Danish Money Museum's special exhibition Governor Torben Nielsen's speech at the opening of the Danish Money Museum's special exhibition celebrating the 200th anniversary of the savings bank movement in Denmark Thank you for the invitation to participate in the celebration of the 200th anniversary of the savings bank movement in Denmark. I have been asked to talk about the development of savings banks up to the present day, which is a special honour for me, who was employed by Den Sjaellandske Bondestands Sparekasse. Today it is exactly 200 years since the savings bank at Holsteinborg Estate was founded. By its very nature, it can only be a short sketch of the development  there should also be time to enjoy the exciting exhibition. The establishment of a savings and loan fund for the benefit of the common people at Holsteinborg Estate in 1810 is traditionally regarded as the entry of the savings bank movement into Danish monetary history. And it is, if by Denmark you mean "the Kingdom of Denmark". But Denmark was then a composite whole state, which in addition to the kingdom included Schleswig and Holstein. And in Germany, at the turn of the 19th century, savings banks had already been known for decades. The first savings bank in the Danish monarchy was founded in Kiel as early as 1796, and another savings bank saw the light of day in Altona in 1801. In a way, we actually also had a savings bank in the Kingdom of Denmark itself before 1810. In 1795 the government established the General Maintenance Institution. It was primarily a life insurance company, but the company had among its departments a so-called "savings fund". Here you could make deposits for a return of 3 per cent p.a. But the savings bank, which Lehnsgreve Frederik Adolph Holstein to Holsteinborg founded in 1810, was in any case the first private savings bank in the Danish kingdom. The savings bank's goal was to promote thrift among the region's less prosperous residents. The savings bank only gave interest on small deposits below 150 rigsdaler. It was offered to store sums over 150 rigsdaler, but it was not considered necessary to give interest to holders of such large deposits! Page 1 of 5 After a few years, Holsteinborg's savings bank had to admit that all new initiatives require a certain amount of adaptation time. From 1818, the agrarian crisis put a significant damper on savings. Thus, in the years 1818-21, not so much as a single dime was inserted into the box. Holsteinborg's savings bank, however, managed to celebrate its 175th anniversary before it was merged with Bikuben in the second half of the 1980s. During the 1820s and 1830s, about 20 new savings banks were founded in Denmark. The savings banks placed a large part of the deposited funds for passive return with the state or Danmarks Nationalbank rather than lending the funds to businesses and households. It was increasingly made the subject of public criticism, and the access of savings banks to place funds for remuneration with the state gradually fell away. Other placement options therefore increasingly had to be found, and during the 1840s and 1850s, savings banks developed into playing a central credit-giving role in the Danish economy. This was particularly true in relation to the financing of housing, agriculture and handicrafts. Denmark's first commercial bank, Fyens Diskonto Kasse, was established in Odense in 1846, and over the next few decades a number of banks were established. By 1873, the country had a total of 27 banks, including the 3 main banks that came to dominate the banking structure for the next 100 years. These were Privatbanken (established in 1857), Den Danske Landmandsbank (established in 1871) and Handelsbanken (established in 1873). The savings banks had now really got competition. However, there was also talk of a certain division of labor. The core area of the savings banks was agriculture and the rural population, while the banks concentrated on the credit needs of urban industries and urban residents. However, it took until 1913 for the banks' total deposits to exceed those of the savings banks. The first part of the 1870s was marked by a boom, and the number of savings banks in Denmark reached more than 300. In 1873, the international economy was hit by a prolonged downturn, which a few years later reached Denmark. The first part of the 1870s was marked by a sharp struggle between banks and savings banks to attract deposits. This drove up deposit rates and reduced savings banks' earnings and the possibility of building up reserves. The development led several savings banks to enter riskier businesses, including the purchase of foreign securities. Furthermore, the liquidity of the savings banks came under pressure, and many savings banks in the years 1877-78 had to finance the decline in the deposit mass through borrowing from Danmarks Nationalbank. Several savings banks came into crisis in the second half of the 1870s. As so many times since, the crisis was followed by legislative initiatives, and in 1880 the first Danish Savings Bank Act was passed. The act subjected the savings banks to supervision and imposed, among other things, certain requirements on soundness, accounting and auditing. Banks were not subject to public supervision and were still not subject to separate legislation. This was the beginning of the law- Page 2 of 5 differentiation between banks and savings banks, which should take about 100 years to offset again. In the early 1900s, the banking system expanded tremendously during a period of severe boom and construction boom, especially in Copenhagen. But at some point, the business cycle reversed, and several banks were hit hard by the crisis. The country's largest savings bank also got into trouble in those years. In 1908, former Minister of Justice P. A. Alberti reported himself to the police and confessed that as director of the Savings Bank of the Zealand Peasants' Association and the Butter Export Association, he had committed frauds. Alberti had, among other things, sold out of the savings bank's bond holdings at the same time as he had made a false depositary certificate, which showed that the bonds were in Privatbanken. The Savings Bank of the Zealand Peasants' Bank had to be reconstructed, and Alberti was sentenced to 8 years of chastisement in 1910, which, incidentally, was served here in Horsens. After the banking crisis of 1907-08, a commission work was initiated. This led to the first Danish Banking Act of 1919, which came into force the following year. In doing so, banks were also subject to supervision, capital requirements, placement rules, as well as provisions on accounting and auditing. The Savings Bank Act was also revised. Among other things, capital requirements and placement rules were tightened. In the 1920s and early 1930s, a large number of the country's banks again ran into trouble. In the period 1920-33, 39 banks were liquidated, 21 banks merged and 34 banks reconstructed. These figures should be compared with a total number of banks of just over 200 in 1920. The crisis of the interwar period was far more gentle on the country's more than 500 savings banks, which performed relatively well in a time of distrust of the banks. A very large proportion of the banks that went down in the interwar period had lent more than 50 per cent of the equity to a single borrower. This led to a tightening of the Banking Act on this point in 1930. Further, the requirements for banks' capital and liquidity were tightened. The Savings Bank Act was revised some years later, in 1937. This included stricter liquidity requirements and more detailed placement rules to ensure that funds were placed in a safe manner. Among other things, there was a requirement that the savings banks that still discounted bills of exchange should cease to do so after a transitional period. In line with the shifts in the business structure from agriculture towards industry in the decades after 2. During World War II, the savings banks gradually lost market position to the banks. It also played into the fact that, especially from the 1960s, banks were increasingly focusing on employees as customers. It had hitherto been one of the savings banks' core segments. In 1950, the savings banks accounted for 47 per cent of the banks' total deposit volume. 25 years later, the share had been reduced to 30 per cent. Furthermore, the development of the savings bank sector was characterised by rapid consolidation. The number of savings banks fell from 506 in 1950 to 206 in 1975, of which the two largest savings banks accounted for almost 60 per cent in terms of total assets. Page 3 of 5 The 1960s were the decade when electronic data processing made its way into the Danish savings banks. However, only the largest savings banks acquired their own computer systems, e.g. Bikuben in 1966. Many smaller savings banks instead used the common computer central, Sparekassernes DataCentral, which was established in 1963. In 1968, 75 savings banks used SDC as a data provider. The 1960s also saw major changes in Danmarks Nationalbank's management of the banks' liquidity as part of its efforts to control the development of inflation and the balance of payments. In 1965, Danmarks Nationalbank entered into deposit agreements with the organisations of banks and savings banks. According to the agreement with Danmarks Sparekasseforening, the savings banks were to deposit a certain percentage of their deposit increase in Danmarks Nationalbank or place the funds in bonds. The deposit schemes were abolished again in 1970, but were replaced by a direct cap on the lending commitments of banks and savings banks. This so-called lending ceiling lasted until 1980, when monetary policy was gradually reoriented towards the more market-oriented instruments we know today. One can philosophize about the effect of the 1970s lending ceiling on the structural development of the financial sector. Successive chairmen of the Savings Bank Association consistently expressed a desire to have the lending ceiling abolished. Others, on the other hand, have expressed the fact that the lending ceiling helped to freeze the structure between the banks. This relieved some of the competitive pressure from the banks, which the savings banks found themselves under in those years. With a new joint law on banks and savings banks, the savings banks in 1975 were given the opportunity to carry out the same business as banks. The savings banks now had access to discount bills of exchange, issue guarantees, trade in shares and bonds at their own expense, participate in share issues and trade in foreign currency. Thus, it was in fact only the name, the form of organization and tax matters that separated savings banks from banks. The 1970s Law on Banks and Savings Banks had been a long time coming. And although the initiative to do so came from the savings banks, the process was marked by a certain disagreement among the savings banks about the desirability of this equality. All other things being equal, the price for gender equality was increased competition between banks and savings banks. In 1989, it became possible for the savings banks to transform themselves from self-governing institutions into limited liability companies and thus the opportunity to raise capital via the stock market. Thus, the Danish banks and savings banks were legislatively fully equal. Already the following year, the Danish Bankers Association was formed by a merger between Bankforeningen and Danmarks Sparekasseforening. 1990 was also the year when Sparekassen SDS, Privatbanken and Andelsbanken joined forces to form Unibank. The division of the past between banks and savings banks was thus really becoming blurred, also in practice. Page 4 of 5 One can debate whether the savings bank concept is still alive today, and if so, what it contains. Is it only the name and history that remain, or are there also certain special cultural and attitudinal aspects associated with being a savings bank. I'll leave that discussion to others, though. Perhaps it is a bit with the savings bank concept as with the philosophy teacher's old knife: first it got a new handle and then a new leaf. But it was still the same good old knife. With these words, I want to end and wish you a lot of fun with the exhibition. Page 5 of 5
text_original: Torben Nielsens tale ved bningen af Dansk Pengemuseums srudstilling Nationalbankdirektr Torben Nielsens tale ved bningen af Dansk Pengemuseums srudstilling til fejring af 200-ret for sparekassebevgelsen i Danmark Tak for indbydelsen til at deltage i fejringen af 200-ret for sparekassebevgelsen i Danmark. Jeg er blevet bedt om at tale om sparekassernes udvikling frem til i dag, hvilket er en srlig re for mig, som i sin tid blev ansat i Den Sjllandske Bondestands Sparekasse. I dag er det prcis er 200 r siden, at sparekassen p Holsteinborg Gods blev stiftet. Iflge sagens natur kan det kun blive et kort rids af udviklingen  der skulle jo ogs gerne vre tid til at nyde den spndende udstilling. Stiftelsen af en spare- og lnekasse til nytte for almuen p Holsteinborg Gods i 1810 regnes traditionelt for sparekassebevgelsens indtog i dansk pengehistorie. Og det er det da ogs, hvis man med Danmark mener kongeriget Danmark. Men Danmark var dengang en sammensat helstat, som ud over kongeriget bl.a. omfattede Slesvig og Holsten. Og i Tyskland havde man ved indgangen til 1800-tallet allerede kendt til sparekasser i rtier. Den frste sparekasse i det danske monarki blev da ogs stiftet i Kiel allerede i 1796, og endnu en sparekasse s dagens lys i Altona i 1801. P sin vis havde vi egentlig ogs en sparekasse i selve kongeriget Danmark fr 1810. I 1795 oprettede regeringen Den almindelige Forsrgelsesanstalt. Der var primrt tale om et livsforsikringsselskab, men selskabet havde blandt sine afdelinger en skaldt "besparelseskasse". Her kunne man foretage indskud til forrentning p 3 pct. p.a. Men den sparekasse, som Lehnsgreve Frederik Adolph Holstein til Holsteinborg stiftede i 1810, var i hvert fald den frste private sparekasse i det danske kongerige. Sparekassen havde som ml at fremme sparsommelighed blandt egnens mindre velstende beboere. Sparekassen gav kun rente p mindre indskud under 150 rigsdaler. Man tilbd gerne at opbevare summer over 150 rigsdaler, men det blev ikke anset for ndvendigt at give rente til indehavere af s store indskud! Side 1 af 5 Holsteinborgs sparekasse mtte efter nogle r erkende, at alle nye tiltag krver en vis tilvnningstid. Fra 1818 lagde landbrugskrisen en betydelig dmper p opsparingen. I rene 1818-21 blev der sledes ikke indsat s meget som n eneste skilling i kassen. Holsteinborgs sparekasse nede dog at fejre sit 175 rs jubilum, fr den i anden halvdel af 1980'erne blev sammenlagt med Bikuben. I lbet af 1820'erne og 1830'erne blev der stiftet omkring 20 nye sparekasser i Danmark. Sparekasserne placerede en stor del af de indskudte midler til passiv forrentning hos staten eller Nationalbanken frem for at lne midlerne ud til erhverv og husholdninger. Det blev i stigende grad gjort til genstand for kritik i offentligheden, og sparekassernes adgang til at placere midler til forrentning hos staten faldt gradvis bort. Man mtte derfor i stigende grad finde andre placeringsmuligheder, og i lbet af 1840'erne og 1850'erne udviklede sparekasserne sig til at spille en central kreditgivende rolle i den danske konomi. Det gjaldt navnlig i forhold til finansiering af boliger, landbrug og hndvrk. Danmarks frste forretningsbank, Fyens Diskonto Kasse, blev oprettet i Odense i 1846, og i lbet af de nste par rtier blev en rkke banker oprettet. I 1873 havde landet i alt 27 banker, herunder de 3 hovedbanker, der kom til at dominere bankstrukturen de nste 100 r. Det drejede sig om Privatbanken (oprettet i 1857), Den Danske Landmandsbank (oprettet i 1871) og Handelsbanken (oprettet i 1873). Sparekasserne havde nu for alvor fet konkurrence. Der var dog ogs tale om en vis arbejdsdeling. Sparekassernes kerneomrde var landbrug og landbefolkningen, mens bankerne koncentrerede sig om byerhvervenes og bybeboernes kreditbehov. Man skulle dog helt frem til 1913, fr bankernes samlede indln oversteg sparekassernes. Den frste del af 1870'erne var prget af hjkonjunktur, og antallet af sparekasser i Danmark nede her op over 300. I 1873 blev den internationale konomi ramt af et lngerevarende tilbageslag, som et par r senere nede Danmark. Den frste del af 1870'erne var prget af en skarp kamp mellem banker og sparekasser om at tiltrkke indskud. Det drev indlnsrenterne op og forringede sparekassernes indtjening og mulighed for opbygning af reserver. Udviklingen fik flere sparekasser til at g ind i mere risikable forretninger, bl.a. kb af udenlandske vrdipapirer. Endvidere kom sparekassernes likviditet under pres, og mange sparekasser mtte i rene 1877-78 finansiere nedgangen i indlnsmassen via lntagning i Nationalbanken. Adskillige sparekasser kom i krise i den anden halvdel af 1870'erne. Som s mange gange siden blev krisen fulgt op af lovgivningsmssige initiativer, og i 1880 blev den frste danske Sparekasselov vedtaget. Loven underlagde sparekasserne tilsyn og stillede bl.a. visse krav til soliditet, regnskab og revision. Bankerne blev ikke underlagt offentligt tilsyn og var fortsat ikke underlagt srskilt lovgivning. Dette blev begyndelsen til den lov- Side 2 af 5 givningsmssige differentiering mellem banker og sparekasser, som det skulle tage omkring 100 r at udligne igen. I begyndelsen af 1900-tallet ekspanderede banksystemet voldsomt under en periode med kraftig hjkonjunktur og byggeboom, isr i Kbenhavn. Men p et tidspunkt vendte konjunkturerne, og flere banker blev hrdt ramt af krisen. Landets strste sparekasse kom ogs i problemer i disse r. I 1908 meldte forhenvrende justitsminister P. A. Alberti sig selv til politiet og tilstod, at han som direktr for Den Sjllandske Bondestands Sparekasse og Smreksportforeningen havde beget bedragerier. Alberti havde bl.a. solgt ud af sparekassens obligationsbeholdning samtidig med, at han havde lavet et falsk depotbevis, som viste, at obligationerne l i Privatbanken. Den Sjllandske Bondestands Sparekasse mtte rekonstrueres, og Alberti blev idmt 8 rs tugthus i 1910, som i vrigt blev afsonet her i Horsens. Efter bankkrisen i 1907-08 blev der igangsat et kommissionsarbejde. Det frte til den frste danske Banklov af 1919, som trdte i kraft ret efter. Hermed blev bankerne ogs underkastet tilsyn, kapitalkrav, placeringsregler samt bestemmelser om regnskab og revision. Sparekasseloven blev ligeledes revideret. Bl.a. blev kapitalkrav og placeringsregler skrpet. I 1920'erne og begyndelsen af 1930'erne lb en lang rkke af landets banker igen ind i problemer. I perioden 1920-33 blev 39 banker likvideret, 21 banker fusioneret og 34 banker rekonstrueret. Disse tal skal sammenholdes med et samlet antal banker p godt 200 i 1920. Krisen i mellemkrigstiden var langt mere sknsom over for landets mere end 500 sparekasser, som klarede sig relativ godt i en tid med mistillid til bankerne. En meget stor del af de banker, som gik ned i mellemkrigstiden, havde udlnt mere end 50 pct. af egenkapitalen til en enkelt lntager. Det frte til en opstramning af Bankloven p dette punkt i 1930. Endvidere blev kravene til bankernes kapital og likviditet strammet. Sparekasseloven blev revideret nogle r senere, i 1937. Det indebar bl.a. skrpede likviditetskrav og mere detaljerede placeringsregler, s det blev sikret, at midlerne blev anbragt p betryggende vis. Der var bl.a. krav om, at de sparekasser, der endnu diskonterede veksler, skulle ophre hermed efter en overgangsperiode. I takt med forskydningerne i erhvervsstrukturen fra landbrug mod industri i rtierne efter 2. Verdenskrig tabte sparekasserne gradvis markedsposition til bankerne. Det spillede ligeledes ind, at bankerne isr fra 1960'erne i stigende grad satsede p lnmodtagere som kunder. Det havde hidtil vret et af sparekassernes kernesegmenter. I 1950 stod sparekasserne for 47 pct. af pengeinstitutternes samlede indlnsmasse. 25 r senere var andelen reduceret til 30 pct. Endvidere var udviklingen i sparekassesektoren kendetegnet ved en hastig konsolidering. Antallet af sparekasser faldt fra 506 i 1950 til 206 i 1975, hvoraf de to strste sparekasser tegnede sig for knap 60 pct. mlt p de samlede aktiver. Side 3 af 5 1960'erne blev rtiet, hvor elektronisk databehandling gjorde sit indtog i de danske sparekasser. Det var dog kun de strste sparekasser, som anskaffede egne EDB-systemer, fx Bikuben i 1966. Mange mindre sparekasser anvendte i stedet den flles EDB-central, Sparekassernes DataCentral, der blev oprettet i 1963. I 1968 benyttede 75 sparekasser SDC som dataleverandr. 1960'erne bd ligeledes p store omvltninger i Nationalbankens styring af pengeinstitutternes likviditet som led i bestrbelserne p at kontrollere udviklingen i inflation og betalingsbalance. I 1965 indgik Nationalbanken deponeringsaftaler med bankernes og sparekassernes organisationer. Iflge aftalen med Danmarks Sparekasseforening skulle sparekasserne deponere en vis procentdel af deres indlnsstigning i Nationalbanken eller placere midlerne i obligationer. Deponeringsordningerne blev afskaffet igen i 1970, men blev aflst af et direkte loft over bankernes og sparekassernes udlnstilsagn. Dette skaldte udlnsloft varede helt frem til 1980, hvor pengepolitikken gradvist blev omlagt i retning af de mere markedsorienterede instrumenter, som vi kender i dag. Man kan filosofere over, hvilken effekt 1970'ernes udlnsloft havde for strukturudviklingen i den finansielle sektor. Skiftende formnd for Sparekasseforeningen gav konsekvent udtryk for et nske om at f udlnsloftet afskaffet. Andre har derimod givet udtryk for, at udlnsloftet bidrog til at fastfryse strukturen mellem pengeinstitutterne. Det lettede noget af det konkurrencemssige pres fra bankerne, som sparekasserne befandt sig under i disse r. Med en ny flles Lov om banker og sparekasser fik sparekasserne i 1975 mulighed for at udfre de samme forretninger som banker. Sparekasserne havde nu adgang til at diskontere veksler, udstede garantier, handle med aktier og obligationer for egen regning, deltage i aktieemissioner samt handle med fremmed valuta. Hermed var det i realiteten kun navn, organisationsformen og skatteforhold, som adskilte sparekasser fra banker. 1970'ernes Lov om banker og sparekasser havde vret lnge undervejs. Og selv om initiativet hertil udgik fra sparekasserne, var forlbet prget af en vis indbyrdes uenighed blandt sparekasserne om det nskelige i denne ligestilling. Prisen for ligestillingen var alt andet lige get konkurrence mellem banker og sparekasser. I 1989 blev det muligt for sparekasserne at omdanne sig fra selvejende institutioner til aktieselskaber og dermed mulighed for at hente kapital via aktiemarkedet. Hermed var de danske banker og sparekasser lovgivningsmssigt fuldt ligestillet. Allerede ret efter blev Finansrdet dannet ved en fusion mellem Bankforeningen og Danmarks Sparekasseforening. 1990 blev ligeledes ret, hvor Sparekassen SDS, Privatbanken og Andelsbanken gik sammen og dannede Unibank. Fortidens opdeling mellem banker og sparekasser var dermed for alvor ved at blive udvisket, ogs i praksis. Side 4 af 5 Man kan diskutere, om sparekassebegrebet stadig lever den dag i dag, og hvad det i givet fald indeholder. Er det kun navnet og historien, der er tilbage, eller er der ligeledes visse srlige kulturelle og holdningsmssige aspekter knyttet til det at vre en sparekasse. Den diskussion vil jeg dog overlade til andre. Mske er det lidt med sparekassebegrebet som med filosofilrerens gamle kniv: Frst fik den nyt skfte og siden nyt blad. Men det var stadig den samme gode gamle kniv. Med disse ord vil jeg slutte og nske rigtig god fornjelse med udstillingen. Side 5 af 5

Title: Comment on article on finans.dk
text: OPINION GOVERNOR LARS ROHDE'S COMMENT ON THE ARTICLE ON FINANCE. Dk 22. january 2016 Henriette Divert-Hendricks has been employed at Danmarks Nationalbank in a fixed-term position of 10 months on the basis of her high qualifications and long experience as a management consultant. It has not entered into consideration of her employment that she is my neighbor. As a rule, positions at Danmarks Nationalbank are advertised, but it is always considered whether there are obvious internal or external candidates. We don't post posts pro forma. In the specific case, the position was not advertised because Henriette Divert-Hendricks had previously worked as an external consultant for Danmarks Nationalbank, her qualifications were therefore known and she was an obvious candidate. Danmarks Nationalbank is not covered by the rules on notices that apply to the state. Page 1 of 1
text_original: UDTALELSE NATIONALBANKDIREKTR LARS ROHDES KOMMENTAR TIL ARTIKEL P FINANS.DK 22. januar 2016 Henriette Divert-Hendricks er blevet ansat i Nationalbanken i en tidsbegrnset stilling p 10 mneder p baggrund af hendes hje kvalifikationer og lange erfaring som ledelseskonsulent. Det har ikke indget i overvejelserne om hendes ansttelse, at hun er min nabo. Som udgangspunkt sls stillinger i Nationalbanken op, men det overvejes altid, om der er oplagte interne eller eksterne kandidater. Vi slr ikke stillinger op proforma. I det konkrete tilflde blev stillingen ikke slet op, fordi Henriette Divert-Hendricks forinden havde arbejdet som ekstern konsulent for Nationalbanken, hendes kvalifikationer var derfor kendte og hun var en oplagt kandidat. Nationalbanken er ikke omfattet af de regler om opslag, der glder for staten. Page 1 of 1

text: STATEMENT FROM GOVERNOR HUGO FREY JENSEN IN CONNECTION WITH LOOMIS' PURCHASE OF BKS 19. august 2016 Hugo Frey Jensen says: "We are pleased that a buyer has now been found for Bankernes CashService (BKS). Title: Statement in connection with the UK referendum result
text: OPINION GOVERNOR LARS ROHDE'S STATEMENT IN CONNECTION WITH THE UK REFERENDUM RESULT 24. june 2016 Governor Lars Rohde says: "There are no reasons why the British decision to leave the EU should affect the exchange rate of the krone against the euro. If there is market pressure, Danmarks Nationalbank will do what is necessary to maintain the exchange rate. We have the tools that are needed."

Hvis der mtte komme et markedspres, vil Nationalbanken gre det ndvendige for at fastholde kursen. Vi har de redskaber, der er brug for."

Title: Opinion on the Landsbank of the Faroe Islands
text: Figgarmalaraoio Attn: Barour Nielsen Traoagota 39 Postsmoga 2039 FO-165 Argir The Executive Board Havnegade 5 1093 Copenhagen K Tel: 45 33 63 63 63 Fax 45 33 63 71 01 sekr@nationalbanken.dk Dear Barour, 22. november 2004 C:\DOCUME1\Lpl\LOCAL1\Temp\Notesf64b61\ 4962363.Doc Thank you for your letter of 19 November 2004, in which, on the basis of our telephone conversation of 18 November, you ask Danmarks Nationalbank for an opinion with our views on the tasks of the National Bank. In the Bank, we have noted the debate that the Government's decision to merge Landsbanken and Hagstovan has caused in the Faroese media, including that the National Bank has put forward a number of arguments in press releases of 29 October and 16 November 2004 as to why, in the Bank's view, it is important to maintain its independence. Danmarks Nationalbank should not be involved in the debate on whether a merger of Hagstovan and Landsbanken is appropriate. It is a Faroese matter. However, we have noted that one of the National Bank's arguments for maintaining independence is that it is a central bank. This argument may create uncertainty about who is the central bank and thus the monetary authority of the Faroe Islands. It is therefore crucial for us to establish that there is only one central bank for the Faroe Islands, and that is Danmarks Nationalbank. What characterizes a central bank is that it has certain features: 1. It stands for the issuance of banknotes and coins in the currency area. 2. It can create liquidity by buying assets with claims on itself, i.e. money. 3. It is the "bank of banks", i.e. receives deposits from and gives loans to money and credit institutions in the field of currency. 4. It shall fix the interest rate on deposits and loans of financial institutions and shall affect hence the interest rates in the currency area. Denmark, the Faroe Islands and Greenland form a currency area, as all have the same currency, Danish kroner. Danmarks Nationalbank  and no one else  performs the four above-mentioned functions and is thus the central bank for the entire area. 2 A central bank may have functions other than those closely related to being a monetary authority. It can be, for example, banking for the state, managing the state's debt and compiling financial statistics. Danmarks Nationalbank carries out the tasks in question for Denmark, while Landsbanken handles them for the Faroe Islands. However, these tasks do not determine whether an institution is a central bank and they can, in principle, be performed by others. The fact that Landsbanken is a bank for the government, takes out loans on behalf of the government and compiles financial statistics for the Faroe Islands does not make it a central bank. As the National Bank points out, the national central banks of the euro area have not been settled after the introduction of the single currency, although the responsibility for setting the interest rate has been transferred to the European Central Bank, the ECB. According to landsbanken, it shows that an institution may well be a central bank, even if it does not have its own currency and cannot set its own monetary policy rate. However, this image is misleading. Neither the Deutsche Bundesbank, the Banque de France nor the other central banks of the euro area countries are currently independent central banks, but together with the ECB they form the unified central banking system of the euro area. The NCBs have voting rights in the Governing Council of the ECB, which decides, inter alia, on interest rates, and they are involved in the organisation and export of the single monetary policy as mandated by the ECB. However, the National Bank is not part of Danmarks Nationalbank and has not had monetary policy powers delegated from Danmarks Nationalbank. Therefore, no parallels can be drawn between the institutional set-up of the euro area and the functioning of the National Bank. I have noticed that Finnbogi isakson has referred in the daily newspaper Socialurin to the fact that the law on the National Bank of October 1978 was based on recommendations in a report from 1977 prepared by Henning Holten and I in our capacity as associate professors at the Copenhagen School of Business and the University of Copenhagen, respectively. In this connection, there may be grounds for clarifying several factors. The statement did not make any actual recommendations. It was a review of what tasks one would like for a national bank. The report was based on the then coalition parties' agreement on "Basis for Cooperation after the general elections of 7 November 1974". Here it was stated that they would establish a national bank that "will carry out all usual danmarks nationalbank tasks, but without the right to issue banknotes". The statement mentions some possible central bank tasks, including that a national bank could regulate the banks via injunctions, primarily "requiring the banks to follow certain guidelines in their asset composition, especially with regard to the loans." When this possibility was considered at all, it is because the Faroese credit market in the 1970s was quite isolated in relation to 3 to the Danish as a result of the asymmetric interest tax regime and that the regulation of the banks in those years was considered the most important monetary policy instrument in Denmark. What matters, however, is that the Lagting Act on the National Bank has not at any time granted the Landsbank the type of central bank-like powers. Thus, there is only one central bank for the Faroe Islands, and that is Danmarks Nationalbank. Regards Biography PS: This letter is published on Danmarks Nationalbank's website (
text_original: Fggarmlarai Att: Barur Nielsen Traagta 39 Postsmoga 2039 FO-165 Argir Direktionen Havnegade 5 1093 Kbenhavn K Tlf: 33 63 63 63 Fax 33 63 71 01 sekr@nationalbanken.dk www.nationalbanken.dk Kre Barur, 22. november 2004 C:\DOCUME~1\Lpl\LOKALE~1\Temp\Notesf64b61\ ~4962363.Doc Tak for dit brev af 19. november 2004, hvori du p baggrund af vores telefonsamtale af 18. november anmoder Nationalbanken om en udtalelse med vores synspunkter p Landsbankens opgaver. Vi har i banken noteret os den debat, som landsstyrets beslutning om at sammenlgge Landsbanken og Hagstovan har afstedkommet i de frske medier, herunder at Landsbanken i pressemeddelelser af 29. oktober og 16. november 2004 har fremfrt en rkke argumenter for, hvorfor det efter bankens opfattelse er vigtigt at opretholde dens uafhngighed. Danmarks Nationalbank skal ikke involvere sig nrmere i debatten, om hvorvidt en sammenlgning af Hagstovan og Landsbanken er hensigtsmssig. Det er et frsk anliggende. Vi har dog bemrket, at et af Landsbankens argumenter for at opretholde uafhngighed er, at den er en centralbank. Dette argument kan skabe en usikkerhed om, hvem der er centralbank og dermed pengepolitisk myndighed for Frerne. Det er derfor afgrende for os at sl fast, at der kun er n centralbank for Frerne, og det er Danmarks Nationalbank. Det, der karakteriserer en centralbank, er, at den har bestemte funktioner: 1. Den str for udstedelsen af sedler og mnter i valutaomrdet. 2. Den kan skabe likviditet ved at kbe aktiver med fordringer p sig selv, dvs. penge. 3. Den er "bankernes bank", dvs. modtager indskud fra og giver ln til penge- og kreditinstitutter inden for valutaomrdet. 4. Den faststter renten p pengeinstitutternes indskud og ln og pvirker dermed renterne inden for valutaomrdet. Danmark, Frerne og Grnland udgr et valutaomrde, idet alle har samme valuta, danske kroner. Danmarks Nationalbank  og ingen andre  varetager de fire ovennvnte funktioner og er dermed centralbank for hele omrdet. 2 En centralbank kan have andre funktioner end dem, der snvert knytter sig til at vre pengepolitisk myndighed. Den kan fx vre bank for staten, forvalte statens gld og udarbejde finansiel statistik. Nationalbanken varetager de pgldende opgaver for Danmark, mens Landsbanken varetager dem for Frerne. Disse opgaver er imidlertid ikke afgrende for om en institution er en centralbank, og de kan i princippet udfres af andre. At Landsbanken er bank for landsstyret, optager ln p vegne af landsstyret og udarbejder finansiel statistik for Frerne gr den sledes ikke til en centralbank. De nationale centralbanker i euroomrdet er  som Landsbanken ppeger  ikke afviklet efter introduktionen af den flles mnt, selv om ansvaret for at faststte renten er overdraget til Den Europiske Centralbank, ECB. Iflge Landsbanken viser det, at en institution godt kan vre en centralbank, selv om den ikke har egen valuta og ikke kan faststte sin egen pengepolitiske rente. Dette billede er imidlertid misvisende. Hverken Deutsche Bundesbank, Banque de France eller de vrige centralbanker i eurolandene er i dag selvstndige centralbanker, men sammen med ECB udgr de det samlede centralbank-system i euroomrdet. De nationale centralbanker har stemmeret i ECBs styrelsesrd, som bl.a. trffer beslutning om renten, og de medvirker i tilrettelggelsen og udfrslen af den flles pengepolitik efter mandat fra ECB. Landsbanken er imidlertid ikke en del af Nationalbanken og har ikke fet pengepolitiske befjelser delegeret fra Nationalbanken. Der kan derfor ikke trkkes paralleller mellem den institutionelle opbygning i euroomrdet og Landsbankens funktion. Jeg har bemrket, at Finnbogi sakson i dagbladet Socialurin har henvist til, at loven om Landsbanken af oktober 1978 var baseret p anbefalinger i en redegrelse fra 1977, som Henning Holten og jeg udarbejdede i vores egenskab af lektorer ved henholdsvis Handelshjskolen i Kbenhavn og Kbenhavns Universitet. Der kan i den forbindelse vre grund til at prcisere flere forhold. Redegrelsen kom ikke med egentlige anbefalinger. Der var tale om en gennemgang af, hvilke opgaver man kunne tnke sig for en landsbank. Redegrelsen tog udgangspunkt i de davrende koalitionspartiers aftale om "Samarbejdsgrundlag efter lagtingsvalget den 7. november 1974". Her blev det fastslet, at man ville etablere en landsbank, der "skal varetage alle sdvanlige nationalbank-opgaver, dog uden ret til seddeludgivelse". Redegrelsen nvner nogle mulige centralbank-opgaver, herunder at en landsbank kunne regulere pengeinstitutterne via pbud, primrt "krav om at pengeinstitutterne skal flge visse retningslinier i deres aktivsammenstning, navnlig hvad angr udlnene." Nr denne mulighed overhovedet blev overvejet, skyldes det, at det frske kreditmarked i 1970'erne var ret isoleret i forhold 3 til det danske som flge af den asymmetriske renteskatteordning, og at regulering af pengeinstitutterne i de r blev betragtet som det vsentligste pengepolitiske instrument i Danmark. Det afgrende er imidlertid, at lagtingsloven om Landsbanken ikke p noget tidspunkt har tildelt Landsbanken den type centralbank-lignende befjelser. Der er sledes kun n centralbank for Frerne, og det er Danmarks Nationalbank. Venlig hilsen Bodil Nyboe Andersen PS: Dette brev offentliggres p Nationalbankens hjemmeside (www.nationalbanken.dk)

Title: Statement in connection with the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority's decision on Danske Bank's management and governance in Estonian money laundering case

As the country's largest bank, Danske Bank is important for financial stability in Denmark, and the case has damaged the bank's credibility. It is of the utmost importance that, for the sake of the national and international reputation of Danish banks, there is no doubt about the efforts against money laundering. Danmarks Nationalbank anticipates Danske Bank's measures to comply with the orders and reprimands the bank has received from the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority. Page 1 of 1

Title: Statement regarding Fjordbank Mors
text: Statement by Governor Nils Bernstein regarding Fjordbank Mors Finansiel Stabilitet A/S has taken over assets and part of the liabilities in Fjordbank Mors. This is the second time that the rules of Bank Package III have been applied. Bank Package III ensures that customers' ordinary banking transactions, such as payments with Dankort, can continue to be carried out even if the bank is settled. "The situation around Fjordbank Mors is boring, but a fair and orderly resolution of the bank has been ensured. The Danish banks are generally healthy and well consolidated, and there has been  and is happening  a great effort to strengthen earnings and capital base as well as reduce vulnerability. Many of the problems that we have seen are due to exposures outside the bank's usual business area and geographical affiliation. We continue to be in an adaptation process. It is important that those banks that have problems seek to address them through adjustments in the balance sheet or mergers. The Board of Directors and the Executive Board of the individual bank are responsible for assessing the bank's situation and for early contacting the authorities so that a solution can be found before we are faced with bankruptcy," says Governor Nils Bernstein.
